purpose: Non-destructive reconciliation delta for the central Publisher family ledger and handoff.

replacement_fields.invention_capture: working technical disclosure complete from verified written-description sources
replacement_fields.disclosure_chronology: intake template complete; attributable evidence not populated
replacement_fields.evidence_map: limitation-level written-description map complete; canonical executable combination support pending
replacement_fields.prior_art_distinction_notes: bounded non-legal technical comparison notes complete; verified external search required
replacement_fields.specification: bounded working disclosure present; full specification incomplete
replacement_fields.claim_themes: candidate limitation leads present; not final claims
replacement_fields.drawings: figure plan complete; formal drawings blocked by missing executable schemas, fixtures, and traces
replacement_fields.counsel_questions: separate, dependent, continuation, numbered-family mapping, claim-cluster, or non-patent disposition unresolved
replacement_fields.warning_resolution: blocked on executable evidence, chronology, contributors, counsel, and owner disposition

legal_notice: This delta is technical tracking only and does not authorize filing, determine legal family boundaries, inventorship, ownership, patentability, disclosure consequences, application numbers, receipts, or deadlines.
